Ok, in fairness, I removed “later.” My suggested text is factual and neutral in tone, and takes a compromise with what you wish to include into account. Speaking of criticism, my understanding of encyclopedic tone is that criticism of a subject should be directly attributed in the text, and that by not doing so, the text is directly making a value judgment on the subject.
